layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B - High Density Grid for Release Artifact Data

key_components.name: Header & Storage Status Bar
key_components.description: Sticky top bar with S3 Bucket Connection status, AWS Region pill, Live Sync trigger button, and theme toggle.

key_components.name: Latest Release Hero Banner
key_components.description: Tactical hero card displaying the latest S3 folder name, timestamp, total file count, total release size, and quick 'Download All' batch trigger.

key_components.name: Artifact Filter & Search Bar
key_components.description: Search input for filtering files by extension, name, or checksum, plus category pill filters (Binaries, Archives, Configs, Checksums).

key_components.name: Artifact Files Table / Card Grid
key_components.description: Interactive data table/grid listing files inside the latest release with S3 key, size, last modified, checksum copy button, link expiration timer badge, and individual download action button.

key_components.name: Expiring Download Link Modal & Toast
key_components.description: Displays the short-lived presigned AWS S3 URL with a 15-minute countdown clock, direct copy link button, and auto-download launcher.

key_components.name: Empty, Loading & Error States
key_components.description: Custom high-tech skeletal shimmer for loading state, animated AWS S3 disconnect error alert with retry button, and empty bucket state.

image_urls.description: Server datacenter network lights for tactical background accent

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern React frontend with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Target JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in package.json.
Implement the FastAPI backend endpoints to list S3 folders, find the latest dated folder, parse contents, and generate 15-minute S3 presigned URLs using boto3.
In the UI, provide live countdown timers for active presigned URLs (15:00 min duration) that show remaining valid time.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, filters, search, table rows) includes the required data-testid attributes.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when presigned links are copied or generated.
Never use pure black or transparent dropdowns without backdrop-blur.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA / APCA compliant high contrast for dark mode.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.interactive_states: Hover, active, focus-visible ring, and disabled state styling on all inputs and buttons.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.accessibility: Aria attributes on modals, tooltips, and file table, keyboard navigable dropdowns.
